stem:
A student used this graphic organizer to classify different figures.

Which figures belong in the part of the organizer labeled "Isosceles triangles"?

options.label: G
options.text: Figures I, III, and V only

options.label: J
options.text: Figures II, IV, and V only

visual_elements: Two concentric circles labeled "Triangles" (outer) and "Isosceles triangles" (inner).
Rectangle with five figures labeled I to V, each a triangle with side congruence or right angle marks.
